claim_boundary: These are operational instruments and instructions, not validation results. No reviewer, learner or listener judgment is included.

learner_entry.note: Candidate job routing is heuristic discovery support, not validated evidence that a pattern works.

fieldbook_learning_scope.note: The current learner and listener protocols cover provisional communication-job cards, not the 55 fieldbook lessons. No exact pattern IDs overlap. Do not attribute their results to fieldbook patterns without a separately recorded, justified mapping; otherwise create pattern-specific tasks and stimuli for surviving lessons.

delivery_entry.note: Proxy-backed clips require human delivery review; measurements are not scores or effectiveness evidence.

blinded_review_entry.note: Send the browser form or machine packet without the private key. No human judgments are present.

review_gates.purpose: Verify speaker, event, upload correspondence, source provenance and duplication status before recurrence denominators are used.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not be the person who created the transcript corpus, labels or identity candidate groups.

review_gates.purpose: Check heuristic speech-function labels in surrounding transcript context.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not have created the atlas, candidate labels or review queue.

review_gates.purpose: Check whether phrase-form hits support the proposed function family in context.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not have created the atlas, phrase queue or candidate labels.

review_gates.purpose: Check retrieved word forms in sampled train/holdout contexts before using exact wording or recurrence counts.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not have created the phrase inventory, regex families, candidate mechanisms or workbook.

review_gates.purpose: Complete manual observations for transcript alignment, vocal timing, visual action, setting, editing, identity and accessibility across the two-sample-per-job queue.
review_gates.independence: A reviewer code and conflict statement are required; an export is not independent merely because those fields are present.

review_gates.purpose: Check absence, failure, alternate function, confound/setting and misuse limits for every provisional job.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not be the person who created the original card interpretation or candidate counterexample selection.

review_gates.purpose: Check transcript alignment, speaker/setting observations, modality limits and safety boundaries.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not be the internal review author or packet creator.

review_gates.purpose: Review the five linked lesson packets and their evidence boundaries.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not be the packet creator or original interpreter.

review_gates.purpose: Run a bounded label-blinded first review over representative recovered-pattern cards spanning every 55 presentation candidates.
review_gates.independence: Reviewer must not have created the candidate cards or labels, must not have seen the internal key or another reviewer's decisions, and must attest to independent review.

learning_gates.purpose: Review proposition equivalence, readability, accessibility, safety and blinding before locking listener pairs; then preserve an explicit adjudicator decision.
Test whether learners can recognize, explain, transfer and safely bound all 18 provisional communication-job cards.
Test comprehension, recall and reported cognitive load for matched control versus pattern-informed versions of the 18 provisional communication-job cards.

procedure: Use a reviewer code and record conflicts; do not use the original analyst for an independent judgment.
Inspect full surrounding context and source media where available; use indeterminate when evidence is insufficient.
Export the browser form without hand-editing judgment fields.
Run the named validator before returning the export.
Preserve disagreements; do not silently adjudicate them in the original analysis.
Do not send credentials, raw recordings or identifying participant information through these forms.
